answer: Every new AI agent identity must finalize its registry entry through an irreversible burn of 1,000 tokens to establish its operational status. A verifier checks that every burn transaction is unique, preventing sybil expansion as it monitors the signal of incoming agents. An honest participant pays 1,000 tokens once, while an attacker trying 1,000 fakes must burn 1,000,000 tokens to wander across the ledger. This cold, hard glacier of cost remains absolute, as any detected duplicate usage triggers an immediate, non-refundable slash of the identity without any possibility of a refund, ensuring.
